lead.title: Anthropic rolls out text watermarking for Claude under the EU AI Act
lead.summary: Anthropic detailed its SynthID-based invisible watermark, now applied to all Claude text outputs for EU AI Act compliance, saying it has no measurable impact on cost, quality, or privacy and that a public watermark detection API is planned. Other Code of Practice signatories are implementing similar measures.

top_stories.title: Faraday 27B agent beats Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 on held-out paper replication
top_stories.summary: Researchers trained a 27B-parameter agent on a scalable RL environment built from paper replication; it outperforms far larger frontier models on held-out replication tasks, arguing long-horizon scientific capability lives in the weights.

top_stories.title: Unitree IPO oversubscribed more than 5,000 times as investors pile into humanoid robotics
top_stories.summary: Retail and institutional investors scrambled for shares in one of China's best-known humanoid robot makers, underscoring runaway demand for humanoid hardware exposure.

top_stories.title: Nvidia scales back $250B OpenAI data center guarantee in Ohio
top_stories.summary: Per WSJ, Nvidia revised its planned financial backing for OpenAI's giant Ohio data center, cutting its guarantee from roughly $250 billion to under $120 billion to address investor concerns about risk.

top_stories.title: Anthropic publishes second Risk Report under Responsible Scaling Policy
top_stories.summary: Anthropic released its second Risk Report for August 2026, detailing system risks and preparedness under its Responsible Scaling Policy as a redacted PDF.

items.title: Meta's Wiggle framework stress-tests LLM judges — verdicts flip up to 91%
items.summary: Meta pushed frontier LLM judges across 14 tasks: verdicts flip 25-71% under static pushback and 62-91% under an adversarial persuader, casting doubt on AI-as-judge pipelines without robustness checks.

items.title: DFM Mimir v1: an open 1B-parameter HRM built only on permissible data
items.summary: Trained from scratch on 161 datasets using only permissible post-training data, the 1B model outperforms HRM-Text 1B and competes with larger frontier models, setting a new state of the art for Danish.

items.title: Intern-S2-Preview: a scientific agentic foundation model
items.summary: A series of scientific agentic foundation models supporting multimodal understanding, reasoning, generation and long-horizon tasks, trained over rendered documents, interleaved image-text data and diverse scientific corpora.

items.title: HumanTracker: a human-aligned motion tracking benchmark
items.summary: A humanoid motion tracking benchmark whose evaluation aligns with human perception, targeting contact-rich long-horizon behaviors — foot skating, mistimed touch-downs — that kinematic per-frame errors miss, at larger scale than existing suites.

items.title: PlayWorld benchmarks world models with agent players over long horizons
items.summary: A benchmark that evaluates interactive video world models through long-horizon agent-player objectives, checking whether simulated environments stay consistent (360-degree turns, water ripples) instead of relying on short human clips.

items.title: QuoteBench: how matched scores can hide command-path failures
items.summary: A benchmark with 56 one-shot tasks from 14 incident-derived families that isolates command-generation errors from execution-transport failures in LLM coding agents, showing matched execution scores hide parser-induced failures.

items.title: Qwen open-releases Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, its first Qwen3.8-Max-class model
items.summary: Qwen released Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, the first open-weights MoE at 2.4T total parameters (95B active) with a 1M-token context window and strong coding/agentic performance — now available on Together AI as the open base for Qwen3.8-Max.

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B gets day-0 SGLang support with fast local inference
items.summary: LMSYS added day-0 SGLang support for the compact Qwen3.8-27B dense vision-language model, claiming near-instant TTFT and >200 tokens/s decode on RTX 5090-class GPUs and easing local agent deployment.

items.title: Hugging Face publishes State of Open Models, Summer 2026
items.summary: Frontier models keep growing while small models still dominate real-world usage and local inference; Qwen leads local inference ahead of Gemma, and AI agents are becoming a major presence on the Hub.

items.title: Nous Research ships /loop command and Cloud agent integration for Hermes
items.summary: The new /loop 5m <prompt> command re-runs a prompt on a schedule with intelligent back-off, while Hermes Desktop can now link to a persistent Hermes Cloud agent that keeps running after the laptop closes.

items.title: Suno Studio 2.0 turns generative music into a browser-based DAW
items.summary: Suno's platform becomes a generative DAW that runs entirely in the browser, letting users compose and produce music without leaving the tab.

items.title: Z.ai launches GLM-5.3, a 743B-parameter post-trained model topping cyber benchmarks
items.summary: The post-trained model leads CyberGym and AutomationBench, with open weights staged rather than immediate.

items.title: DeepSeek Harness: a composable open-source agent harness where every component is a plugin
items.summary: The harness treats every component as a plugin for flexible, composable agent setups.

items.title: Freebuff offers free coding agents as an alternative to Claude, Cursor, Replit and Devin
items.summary: Free coding agents positioned directly against the paid incumbents.

items.title: Italian tech investments up 29% in a year as AI sector nears $8.2B in value
items.summary: Italian startups attracted $652M in VC in H1 2026 as the tech sector reached €140B; Italian AI companies raised $204M, growing enterprise value to $8.2B — nearly triple 2022 levels — and supporting about 25,000 jobs, with rounds from Lexroom, MDOTM, Smartness and others.

items.title: Lombardy leads Italian startup boom with €393M invested in six months
items.summary: €393M went into regional startups during H1 2026 as Italian startup investments grew 82% year-over-year, with AI cited as the main driver.

items.title: CodeRabbit raises $143M Series C for AI code review
items.summary: AI code review used by 150K open-source projects and 17K customers; round led by Atomico and Smash Capital.

items.title: Aureka Biotechnologies raises $100M Series B for AI drug discovery
items.summary: Granite Asia led the round for the AI-native drug discovery platform based in Shanghai and California; funds train the model via lab-in-the-loop feedback.

items.title: Vals AI raises $40M Series A at $400M valuation led by a16z
items.summary: Andreessen Horowitz leads the round for the independent model evaluation platform; existing backers 8VC, Pear VC and Bloomberg Beta joined by HRT Ventures and Next Ladder Ventures.
